Observed source treatments, with no proposed replacement design
Desktop panels and revised SDDM reuse authored cut corners. Hyprlock uses a generated raster perimeter.
Heading, value, body and metadata roles exist in tokens. Native lock fields retain their own font and rendering rules.
Rail compresses at four widths. Login changes portrait/form composition and supports scrolling.
Desktop controls use shared route/review services. SDDM relies on its greeter proxy. Hyprlock owns secure lock interaction.
Evidence-backed comparison prompts. Classification is a proposal only.
No automatic spacing or alignment defect is inferred from fixture-only content. Evaluate the enlarged crops and real interaction states before deciding.
Initial working proposals. No application changes are authorised by this atlas.
